source_en: Hello, dear. Papers kept under my Bible. Mzia Kakulia, southern block.
I mend from home. Mending matters more than new, these days.
Coats. Socks. You wouldn't believe how many forget spare socks.
Irina helps, when her hands aren't shaking. I don't say anything.
You look thin, dear. Are they feeding you on those coupons?
Mm. I'll worry anyway. Keeps my hands busy.
Kindness is cheaper than medicine, dear. Two husbands taught me.
I always make too much soup. Come by later.
